verdict.rationale: Make's API requires user authentication tokens with "the relevant scopes enabled", which implies scoped, least-privilege credentials. It also documents OAuth 2.0 flows (confidential clients, PKCE, client registration) that could give an agent delegated access. The evidence is thin, though: one line on token scopes and nothing showing tokens issued per agent or for the MCP server. Missing for 10: documentation of available scopes and their granularity, agent-dedicated or MCP-specific credential issuance, token expiry and revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
